newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Madison repeats IBM buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Madison repeats IBM buy.

text.p: - Madison Securities Research repeated a buy recommendation on International Business Machines Corp based, in part, on strength in the company's mainframe, personal computer, server and service businesses.

- Analyst Jeffrey Maxick also cited IBM's reputation as a strong technology partner and its stock repurchase program. In addition, he said IMB's cash warchest of $8 billion allows the company to continue to invest in new technologies through acquisitions, joint ventures, licensing agreements and internal research and development.
- IBM shares were trading up 7-1/8 to 152-7/8.
